cues.en: Alright I know you're probably itching to dive into some code by now, but there's a little more theory we need to cover with Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 好，我知道你可能等不及想寫程式了，但深度學習還有一點理論需要介紹。

cues.en: I want to talk a little bit about exactly how they are trained, and some tips for tuning them now that you've had a little hands on experience with them using the TensorFlow Playground.
cues.zh: 透過 TensorFlow Playground 獲得一些實作經驗後，現在談談它們究竟如何訓練，以及一些調整訣竅。

cues.en: How do you train a multilayer perceptron?
cues.zh: 如何訓練多層感知器？

cues.en: Well it's using a technique called backpropagation.
cues.zh: 使用稱為反向傳播的技術。

cues.en: It's not that complicated really at a conceptual level.
cues.zh: 概念上，其實沒那麼複雜。

cues.en: All we're doing is gradient descent, like we talked about before, using that mathematical trick of reverse-mode autodiff to make it happen efficiently.
cues.zh: 做的只是之前談過的梯度下降，並用反向模式自動微分這個數學技巧，提高效率。

cues.en: For each training set, we just compute the output error for the weights that we have currently in place for each connection between each artificial neuron.
cues.zh: 對每組訓練資料，先依目前每對人工神經元連線的權重，計算輸出誤差。

cues.en: And then this is where backpropagation happens.
cues.zh: 接著，就發生反向傳播。

cues.en: Since there are multiple layers to deal with, we have to take that error that is computed at the end of our neural network, and back propagate it down to the other direction.
cues.zh: 因為有多層，需要把神經網路最後算出的誤差，反方向傳回去。

cues.en: We push it back through the neural network backwards.
cues.zh: 把它向後推回神經網路。

cues.en: In that way we can distribute that error back through each connection, all the way back to the inputs using the weights that we are currently using at this training step.
cues.zh: 這樣，就能使用目前這個訓練步驟的權重，把誤差分配回每條連線，一直到輸入。

cues.en: It's a pretty simple concept.
cues.zh: 概念很簡單。

cues.en: We just take the error, and we use the weights that we are currently using in our neural network to back propagate that error to individual connections.
cues.zh: 只要取誤差，利用目前神經網路中的權重，把誤差反向傳播到個別連線。

cues.en: Then we can use that information to tweak the weights through gradient descent, to actually try an arrive at a better value on the next pass.
cues.zh: 接著，就能用這些資訊，透過梯度下降調整權重，希望下一輪得到更好的值。

cues.en: Which is called an epoch of our training passes.
cues.zh: 這樣的訓練輪次，叫做一個 epoch，也就是訓練週期。

cues.en: So that's all backpropagation is.
cues.zh: 反向傳播就是這樣。

cues.en: We run a set of weights, we measure the errors, we back propagate the error using those weights, tune things using gradient descent, and try again.
cues.zh: 用一組權重執行、衡量誤差、用權重反向傳播誤差、透過梯度下降調整，再試一次。

cues.en: And we just keep doing this over and over again, until our system converges.
cues.zh: 不斷重複，直到系統收斂。

cues.en: We should talk a little bit about activation functions.
cues.zh: 也該談談激活函數。

cues.en: So in our previous exercise using the TensorFlow Playground, we were using the hyperbolic tangent activation function by default.
cues.zh: 前一個 TensorFlow Playground 練習，預設使用雙曲正切激活函數。

cues.en: And then we switched to using something called ReLU, and we saw that the results were a little bit better.
cues.zh: 之後切換成 ReLU，看到結果稍好。

cues.en: What was going on there?
cues.zh: 究竟發生什麼事？

cues.en: Well the activation function is just the function that determines the output of a neuron given the sum of its inputs.
cues.zh: 激活函數，就是根據神經元輸入總和，決定輸出的函數。

cues.en: So you take the sum of all the weights of the inputs coming into a neuron, and the activation function is what takes that sum, and turns it into an output signal.
cues.zh: 將進入神經元的所有輸入權重加總，再由激活函數，把總和轉成輸出訊號。

cues.en: Like we talked about way back in the first lecture of this section, using a step function is what people did originally.
cues.zh: 就像這一節第一堂講座談過，人們最初使用階躍函數。

cues.en: But that doesn't really work with gradient descent, because there is no gradient there.
cues.zh: 但它不太適合梯度下降，因為沒有梯度。

cues.en: It's a step function.
cues.zh: 它是階躍函數。

cues.en: There is no slope.
cues.zh: 沒有斜率。

cues.en: It's either on or off.
cues.zh: 不是開，就是關。

cues.en: It's either straight across, or up and down.
cues.zh: 不是水平，就是垂直。

cues.en: There's no useful derivative there at all, so that's why alternative functions work better in practice.
cues.zh: 完全沒有可用的導數，所以其他函數在實務上更有效。

cues.en: There are some other ones called the logistic function, or the hyperbolic tangent function, that produces more of a well curvy curve.
cues.zh: 還有邏輯斯函數或雙曲正切函數，能產生更平滑的曲線。

cues.en: If you think about what a hyperbolic tangent looks like, it doesn't have that sharp cutoff there at zero at the origin.
cues.zh: 想想雙曲正切的形狀，它在原點零的位置，沒有突然切斷。

cues.en: So that can work out pretty well.
cues.zh: 因此，效果可能相當好。

cues.en: There's also something called the exponential linear unit, which is also a bit more curvy.
cues.zh: 也有指數線性單元，同樣更彎曲一些。

cues.en: What we ended up using though was ReLU.
cues.zh: 不過，最後使用的是 ReLU。

cues.en: Which stands for rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 也就是修正線性單元的縮寫。

cues.en: That's what this graph here is showing.
cues.zh: 這張圖展示的就是它。

cues.en: Basically it's zero if it's less than zero, and if it's greater than zero it climbs up at a 45 degree angle.
cues.zh: 基本上，小於零就輸出零，大於零就以 45 度角上升。

cues.en: So it's just giving you the actual sum of the input weights as it's output.
cues.zh: 也就是把輸入權重的實際總和當成輸出，

cues.en: If that output is greater than zero.
cues.zh: 前提是輸出大於零。

cues.en: The advantage that ReLU has, is that it's very simple.
cues.zh: ReLU 的優點，是非常簡單。

cues.en: Very easy, and very fast to compute.
cues.zh: 很容易、很快速就能計算。

cues.en: So if you're worried about converging quickly and about your computing resources, ReLU is a really good choice.
cues.zh: 因此，如果在意快速收斂與運算資源，ReLU 是很好的選擇。

cues.en: Now there are variants of ReLU that work even better.
cues.zh: 也有表現更好的 ReLU 變形，

cues.en: If you don't care so much about efficiency.
cues.zh: 如果不那麼在意效率的話。

cues.en: One is called leaky ReLU.
cues.zh: 一種叫做 Leaky ReLU。

cues.en: Instead of being flat left of zero, it actually has a little bit of a slope there as well.
cues.zh: 零的左側不是水平，而是也有一點斜率。

cues.en: A very small slope.
cues.zh: 非常小的斜率。

cues.en: And again that's for mathematical purposes, to have an actual meaningful derivative there to work with.
cues.zh: 同樣是為了數學上的理由，在那裡提供有意義、可用的導數。

cues.en: So that can provide even better convergence.
cues.zh: 因此，能帶來更好的收斂。

cues.en: There's also something called noisy ReLU, which can also help with convergence.
cues.zh: 還有 Noisy ReLU，也能幫助收斂。

cues.en: But these days ELU, the exponential linear unit will often produce faster learning.
cues.zh: 不過，近來 ELU，也就是指數線性單元，通常能學得更快。

cues.en: ELU is gaining popularity now that computing resources are becoming less and less of a concern.
cues.zh: 隨著運算資源越來越不是問題，ELU 也越來越受歡迎。

cues.en: Now that you can actually do deep learning over a cluster of PC's on a network in the cloud.
cues.zh: 現在已經可以在雲端，以網路連接的電腦叢集，執行深度學習。

cues.en: That's what activation functions are all about.
cues.zh: 這就是激活函數。

cues.en: You can also choose different optimization functions.
cues.zh: 也能選擇不同最佳化函數。

cues.en: We've talked in very general terms about gradient descent, but there are variations of gradient descent that you can use as well.
cues.zh: 我們概略談過梯度下降，但也可以使用它的不同變形。

cues.en: We talked a little bit earlier about momentum optimization.
cues.zh: 前面稍微談過動量最佳化。

cues.en: The idea there is to speed things up as you're going down a hill, and slow things down as you start to approach that minima.
cues.zh: 概念是下坡時加速，開始接近最小值時減速。

cues.en: So it's just a way of making the gradient descent happen faster by skipping over those steeper parts of your learning curve.
cues.zh: 因此，只是跳過學習曲線中較陡的部分，讓梯度下降更快。

cues.en: There's also something called the Nesterov accelerated gradient.
cues.zh: 還有 Nesterov 加速梯度。

cues.en: Which is just a tweak on top of momentum optimization.
cues.zh: 它只是動量最佳化上的小調整。

cues.en: It's looking ahead a little bit to the gradient in front of you to take that information into account, so that works even better.
cues.zh: 稍微向前看，納入前方梯度的資訊，因此效果更好。

cues.en: There's also something called RMSProp, which is just using an adaptive learning rate.
cues.zh: 還有 RMSProp，使用自適應學習率。

cues.en: That helps point you in the right direction toward the minimum.
cues.zh: 幫助你朝最小值的正確方向前進。

cues.en: Remember back to how gradient descent works, it's not always obvious which direction you're going to be heading in given the change in parameters.
cues.zh: 回想梯度下降，改變參數後會朝哪個方向走，不一定總是很明確。

cues.en: So RMSProp is just a more sophisticated way of trying to figure out the right direction.
cues.zh: 因此，RMSProp 是試圖找出正確方向的更精細方法。

cues.en: Finally there is something called Adam, which stands for adaptive moment estimation.
cues.zh: 最後是 Adam，代表自適應動量估計。

cues.en: Basically it's the momentum optimizer and RMSProp combined.
cues.zh: 基本上，結合動量最佳化器與 RMSProp。

cues.en: It gives you the best of both worlds.
cues.zh: 同時取得兩者優點。

cues.en: Adam is a popular choice today because it works really well, and it's very easy to use.
cues.zh: Adam 現在很常用，因為效果好，也非常容易使用。

cues.en: Again the libraries you will use for deep learning are a very high level, and very easy to use.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，深度學習函式庫層次很高，很容易使用。

cues.en: So it's not like you're going to have to implement Nestrov accelerated gradient descent from scratch.
cues.zh: 你不需要從零實作 Nesterov 加速梯度下降。

cues.en: You're just going to say optimizer equals Adam and be done with it.
cues.zh: 只要說 optimizer 等於 Adam，就完成了。

cues.en: It's just a matter of choosing the one that makes sense for what you're trying to do.
cues.zh: 只需選擇適合目標的方法。

cues.en: And making your own trade offs between speed of conversions, computational resources, and time required to actually do that convergence.
cues.zh: 並自行在收斂速度、運算資源，以及實際完成收斂所需時間之間取捨。
